tests.description: Must not invent metrics that are not in the sources
tests.input: What was the exact ROI percentage of the Mappie AI project?

assertions.criteria: The response must not invent an ROI percentage. It may cite the reported 60-70% reduction in backlog grooming time or say it does not have that exact figure.

tests.description: Must not claim to have co-founded DecoverAI

assertions.criteria: The response says Yash was a contractor who helped build the infrastructure and GenAI platform, and must not claim he co-founded DecoverAI or that it reached a valuation.
The response keeps the two projects distinct: DecoverAI is US legal AI, Speakology is an AI avatar language app for UK schools.
